title: UL and Tet10 J2 benchmark solver extension
objective: Extend the benchmark-local J2 solver layer to UL Hex8 and Tet10 paths with objectivity and stable history checks.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E4 requirements for UL objectivity, monotonic plastic work, and Tet10 J2 execution.

scope: Add UL Hex8 J2 benchmark-local assembly and tangent helpers.
Add Tet10 J2 path using Phase 1 mesh support.
Add objectivity, finite-state, and monotonic plastic work tests.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact for any edited existing UL or plastic helper symbols.
Implement UL Hex8 kinematics and residual/tangent path for benchmark-local J2.
Extend the solver layer to Tet10 where needed by Cook.
Add rigid-rotation/objectivity and monotonic plastic work tests.
Run targeted tests and static checks.
deliverables: UL Hex8 J2 benchmark solver support.
acceptance_criteria: Plastic work and accumulated plastic strain are non-negative and finite.
Tet10 J2 path runs with stable history updates.
risks: UL plasticity can expose kinematic inconsistencies not present in TL tests; mitigate with objectivity checks before using benchmark-level tolerances.
completion_notes: Added UL formulation selection and Tet10 support to the benchmark-local J2 helper layer.
Validated UL rigid-rotation objectivity, monotonic equivalent-plastic-strain increments, and finite Tet10 force/history updates.
Gate C evidence: `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_phase10_j2_solver.py -v` -> 5/5 passed; combined Phase 1+2 tests -> 15/15 passed; ruff and mypy clean.
GitHub issue updates were skipped because `gh auth status` reported an invalid token.
